newsitem.title: USA: CME traders call USDA data bullish to pork bellies.
newsitem.headline: CME traders call USDA data bullish to pork bellies.

text.p: Chicago Mercantile Exchange livestock traders and analysts called the U.S. Agriculture Department's Cold Storage Report bullish for CME pork belly futures, with futures expected to open about 1.00 cent per lb higher on Wednesday.
The report showed May 1 frozen pork belly supplies at 54.017 million lbs, near the mid-range of analysts' estimates but down from the April 1 supply of 54.767 million lbs.
